# Resource Hubs

> Source: https://www.cpaireland.ie
> Site: CPA Ireland
> Scraped: 2026-04-16

> Resource Hubs

#### •   Will I still have access to the Digitalisation Hub and the Sustainability Hub?

Yes you will continue to have access to both hubs through the CPA website. You can access them through the below links:

- Digitalisation Hub
- Sustainability Hub

#### •   Can I still do the sustainability micro-credentials that are linked on the sustainability hub?

Yes, the Sustainability Micro-Credentials will still be available to purchase through the CPA website.

#### •   Will I still be able to access the technical and business resources on the CPA website?

The technical and business resources that are currently available on the CPA website will remain available to members.

#### •   Will I be given access the technical and business resources on the Chartered Accountants Ireland website?

During the transition period, the technical and business resources from the Chartered Accountants Ireland website will be mirrored on the CPA Ireland website to ensure that members have full access.

#### •   What resource hubs do Chartered Accountants Ireland have and will I be able to access them?

Chartered Accountants Ireland have a dedicated Knowledge Centre which contains resource hubs including:

- Technical Hub
- Sustainability Centre
- TaxSource Total
- Ethics Resource Centre
- Member Benefits
- New Member Information Centre
